// Necessary until we move off the Matrix JS SDK.
pref("security.allow_eval_in_parent_process", true);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted Thunderbird profile explicitly sets security.allow_eval_in_parent_process to true with a comment that scopes the need to the Matrix JS SDK migration. The original patch removes a separate explicit system-principal false setting; it does not establish that both preferences have the same default or meaning. The full bug records an initial belief that false was safe, then corrects that belief after a Try run. The assigned review, paired Gecko default implementation and Matrix eval consumer remain uninspected. This is a scoped compatibility fact, not a general recommendation to enable eval. No runtime eval or Matrix test ran.
title: Thunderbird keeps a parent-process eval override tied to the Matrix JS SDK
